choices.reason: The paper does not explicitly label a primary contrast, but its abstract reports the GAI-SDTS design-achievement comparison and Introduction RQ1/RH1 specify GAI-SDTS versus GAI and TDL. Rule 2 therefore selects GAI-SDTS versus TDL before the later preference for a freely used AI arm.
choices.locator: PDF p. 1, abstract, results sentence; corroborated by PDF p. 2, section 1, RQ1 and RH1.
choices.quote: Results showed that students in the GAI-SDTS group achieved higher design achievement, creative self-efficacy, and problem-solving skills than those in the other two groups.
